mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts and retail sales (both above their 3-month moving averages) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average signals a supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 6mo_MA.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 230 indicates elevated inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth level above 13600 billion dollars indicates robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13600.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) signal a stagflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment level above 133,000 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 133000.
